designationHistory.name: Lyndon Baines Johnson Memorial Grove on the Potomac
designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Interior Department to work with a private committee to create a living memorial grove to Lyndon B. Johnson in Lady Bird Johnson Park.
designationHistory.note: The NPS Index gives a dedication date of Sept. 27, 1974, while the NPS History Collection quotes Lady Bird Johnson at a dedication on April 6, 1976; the dedication is not a designation and is not listed.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (p. 43), 'Authorized Dec. 28, 1973'
